name: truncate
summary: Truncate free text to a caller-supplied Unicode-scalar length budget, with an optional ellipsis included inside that budget.
description: Counts Rust char values (Unicode scalar values), not UTF-8 bytes or grapheme clusters. If text already fits within max_length, returns it unchanged with truncated=false. Otherwise, returns at most max_length Unicode scalars with truncated=true: by default a single Unicode ellipsis (…); when a custom ellipsis is supplied, the ellipsis is included inside the same total budget. If the ellipsis itself is longer than max_length it is clipped to the budget, and max_length=0 returns an empty string. This capability is deterministic, memory-only, and does not interpret HTML, display width, or grapheme clusters.

use_cases.scenario: As a note-taking app developer, I want long note text shortened to a fixed preview budget with the default ellipsis included in that budget, so that list rows stay bounded without exceeding the UI limit.
As a note-taking app developer, I want text that already fits the preview budget returned byte-for-byte unchanged, so that short notes are never modified just because the truncation capability ran.

As a note-taking app developer, I want to choose an ASCII ellipsis while keeping it inside the same total length budget, so that clients with a house style can request three dots without overflowing their preview limit.
As a note-taking app developer, I want a zero-length budget to return an empty preview and report that truncation occurred, so that a disabled preview slot has explicit deterministic behavior.

ellipsis.description: Suffix used when truncation occurs; included inside max_length and clipped if longer than the entire budget.

text.description: Original text when it fits; otherwise a prefix plus the requested ellipsis, with total Unicode-scalar length no greater than max_length.

truncated.description: True exactly when the input text exceeded max_length.

preconditions.description: Caller supplies a text string and a non-negative integer max_length; ellipsis is optional and defaults to ….

postconditions.description: Output text contains at most max_length Rust char / Unicode scalar values; max_length=0 yields an empty string.
When the input text contains at most max_length Unicode scalars, output text equals the input exactly and truncated is false.
When truncation occurs, the selected ellipsis is counted inside max_length; if the ellipsis itself exceeds the budget, only its first max_length Unicode scalars are returned.
Identical input yields identical output using only Unicode-scalar counting and deterministic string slicing; see risk.determinism_class.

side_effects.description: Produces a bounded string in memory; does not log, persist, or transmit input text.

provenance.author: Rayan-and-beyond
